Leathernecks came in with a 2% below average attack and a league-average defense (2-1, 59 scored and 69 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 158 and 159 games of evidence. Projected to score 71.4, they scored 74 (+2.6 points, 4% over); projected to allow 69.6, they allowed 41 (−28.6 points, 41% under).

The bigger miss was Rams' scoring (-28.6 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 115 against 140.9 projected (-25.9), about the 3rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Leathernecks by 33 against Leathernecks by 1.8 projected, about the 99th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (CNIA pts scored, CNIA pts allowed, CNIA lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.817 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +32.5 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 365 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.994 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Leathernecks attack ×0.960, defense ×0.970 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 31.2 points), no bet.
